top_signal.title: New Business Phone Service
top_signal.summary: I am opening a new business but am struggling with finding a phone provider for the business. Unfortunately, we cannot get approved for a phone line through AT&T or another company that requires credit checks since we are brand new and have no credit yet.   We were originally going with Spectrum but their customer service has been less than helpful and we cannot even get the equipment we need.   It is a 2 person business located in Wichita KS and we just need a single phone. Any recommendations for services? We are open to options such as Ring Central, Ooma Office, etc. But are nervous about the reviews we've seen for Android devices.       submitted by     /u/oledingus       [link]       [comments]
